# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOLUME_SQUEEZE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When intraday volatility contracts sharply around lunchtime (11:30-13:30 ET), a subsequent volume‑expanded break of the squeeze range signals a mean‑reverting move. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede institutional re‑engagement, and a volume‑confirmed break of the squeezed range indicates a shift in short‑term sentiment that tends to revert toward the day’s VWAP.

## Mechanism

Between 11:30‑13:30 ET, compute the 5‑minute ATR and its 20‑period average. If ATR < 50% of its 20‑period average (volatility squeeze) and price is within 0.1% of VWAP, monitor for a break of the prior 5‑minute high or low. On a break where volume > 1.3× the 20‑period average volume, enter at the close of that 5‑minute bar: long on high break, short on low break. Exit: stop placed at the opposite edge of the squeeze range (chart‑stop). Target: TP1 at 1× risk (50% of position) with runner trailed by 15% of HWM, or fixed 2× risk target.
